host: MacBook Pro, Apple M3 Pro, 18 GiB unified memory, macOS 14.7.8

implementation.variant: memory-adaptive lazy BF16 prefill, independent attention and MLP projections; decode unchanged

methodology.renderer: Independent Metal renderer, 1280x720 at 60 Hz with 1450 shader iterations per pixel (target refresh only). Read on-device utilization every 0.5 s. Frame service time is separate from application latency.
methodology.worker: Local Qwen3.5-0.8B, same installed affine 4-bit source. Each worker warms on one separate clip. No cloud, actual game process, audio device or compositor FPS measurement.
methodology.long: Six distinct chronological thumbnails, generated by the product. Same fixed image bytes, Chinese prompt, deterministic generation, 160-token allowance. Each condition runs one model worker and uses a fixed input order. The eight confirmation clips were repeated in the opposite order with new worker processes. Time from writing the prepared sheet through worker IPC until the complete returned string, including format recovery. All attempts include invalid and truncated replies. Matched complete requires legal scene, a nonempty observation and unique, in-range frame citations. Production parser acceptance is recorded separately, with its 60-character limit and narrower frame-ID syntax.
methodology.native: Original product capture scheduling, six-frame selection, local worker, final parsing and speech-request capture. Local highlight review active, optional single-frame scene-vision/cloud flags disabled. One model worker at a time. Measure published then release, then repeat in opposite order with restarted processes. Warm-up excluded. Source capture, inbox and speaker sink are replaced by the replay harness.
methodology.split: Initial 8 clips and 12 additional clips were used for engineering. The 8 timestamps under confirm were fixed before final candidate selection and excluded from tuning. Warmup is never a measurement. P50 is the median, P95 is nearest rank. Stable IDs compare the exact same image bytes, prompts and returned text.
methodology.audio: Original re-entry, freshness, combat and voice-output behavior also exercised by seven tests against the original revision; no physical speaker or microphone used.

cpu_control.method: Set default device and generation stream to CPU before loading the model. Hide Metal availability from mlx-vlm to skip its GPU wired-memory reservation. Use the same 160-token prompt and a separate warm-up clip.
